name: Strategic Planning / Southeast Task Force Committee Agenda
agenda_text:
Beverly Hills City Council Liaison I Strategic Planning Committee will
  conduct a Regular Meeting, at the following time and place, and will address
  the agenda listed below:

  CITY HALL
  455 North Rexford Drive
  2 Floor, Council Chamber
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  Thursday, March 7, 2079
  5:00 PM

  AGENDA

  1)  Public Comment
  a.  Members of the public will be given the opportunity to directly address the
  Committee on any item not listed on the agenda.

  2)  Discussion with Stakeholders in the La CienegalWilshire Focus Area

  3)  Committee Updates

  4)  Adjournment

  Lourdes Sy-Rodriguez’Assisnt City Clerk

  Posted: February 27, 2019

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, the Council Chamber is wheelchair accessible and
  is equipped with audio equipment for the hearing impaired. If you need special assistance to attend this
  meeting, please call the City Manager’s Office at (310) 285-1014 or TTY (310) 285-6881. Please notify
 the City Clerk’s Office at least forty-eight (48) hours prior to the meeting if you requite captioning service
  so that reasonable arrangements can be made.
minutes_text:
CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 N. Rexford Drive
  2nd Floor Council Chambers
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  Strategic Planning Committee Meeting

  HIGHLIGHTS

  Thursday, March 7, 2019
  5:00 PM
MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time  March 7, 2019/ 5:00pm

IN ATTENDANCE:  Mayor Julian Gold MD, Vice Mayor John Mirisch, City Treasurer
  Howard Fisher, Facilitator Karen Orlansky, City Manager Mahdi
  Aluzri, , Health & Safety Commissioner Myra Lurie, Health & Safety
  Commissioner Daniel Nazarian, Human Relations Commissioner
  Ori Blumenfield, Cultural Heritage Commissioner Craig Corman,
  Sharon Ignarro, Steve Gordon, Anne Ostroff, Director of
  Community Development Susan Healy Keene, Director of Public
  Works Shana Epstein, Director of Community Services Nancy Hunt
  Coffey, Marketing and Economic Sustainability Manager Laura
  Biery, Policy and Management Analyst Cindy Owens, Todd
  Johnson (Chamber), Blair Schlecter (Chamber)

  1.  Public Comment
   None.

  2. Discussion with Stakeholders in the La Cienega/Wilshire Focus Area
   Panel by various stakeholder within the area
   Richard Frank from CEO/Chairman of Lawry’s Restaurants
   Shal Misrali who owns property on S. La Cienaga Blvd.
   Darren Hong from Grayson Luxury
   Abraham Assil with Westland Development Group, who manage
  the Stinking Rose
   Max Argakian who owns several properties on S. La Cienaga
   Shahram Kashfi from NK Beverly Hills
   Julian Javor whose family owns property on La Cienaga Blvd.
   Dr. Michael Hayavi who own property on S. La Cienaga Blvd.
   Masoud Malek who practices on S. La Cienaga Blvd.
   Kayla Pergrem representative from Douglas Emmett who own
  several properties among them one in the Southeast Area.
   Stakeholders discussed the future of traffic and streetscapes of the
  Southeast area
   Input from stakeholders on La Cienaga Park future
   Discussion between stakeholders regarding the types of businesses that
  could thrive within the area.

  3. Committee Updates
     City Council meeting scheduled for April 2; initial concept plan for La
  Cienaga Park and Recreation complex to be presented.
    Future Strategic Planning Committee and Southeast Task Force Area
  Committee meetings will be held as open forum (town hall) style meetings.

4. Confirm Future Meeting Dates
   Next meeting date to be decided after the Mayoral installation on March
  20, 2019.

5. Adjourn
  Date / Time  March 7, 2019/ 6:23pm
